A Simple RCircos Plot Workflow

RCircos.Workflow.Rd

Print out on screen to list procedures for a basic RCircos plot.

Usage

RCircos.Workflow()

Author

Henry Zhang

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(RCircos)
RCircos.Workflow()
} # }
